skill_name: Explain the purpose of principal component analysis
workflow: Principal component analysis (PCA) is a statistical technique used to reduce the dimensionality of data while still preserving most of the information contained in the original dataset. It works by transforming the data into a set of uncorrelated variables, also known as principal components, that explain most of the variance in the data.
